function.arguments: {"is_bug":true,"summary":"The execution completes, but the claimed matched-width contrast is not actually conditioned on time: it separately fits growth and decline shear against width, so shared temporal trends can produce the apparent difference. The reported bootstrap interval is for a different unadjusted raw mean contrast, with direction and width range held fixed and resampling indices independently across blocks, so it does not quantify uncertainty for the displayed smoothed contrast or preserve a proper moving-block resample. Also, the lagged augmentation does not improve blocked scores over the baseline (slightly worse RMSE/MAE), and high residual ACF indicates substantial unmodeled serial dependence. Revise the matched contrast to estimate growth-direction effect conditional on both width and time, use a block bootstrap that refits that same estimand, and characterize dependence/validation uncertainty; interpret current output as no predictive evidence for added memory."}
